719050101.text: Tell me about the Guhua Clan.

719050102.text: Ah, the mere mention of it takes me back. I do wonder what everyone's doing these days, you know, my master and all the others I trained with...

719050103.text: As for me, I'm more than happy that I can combine keen bladework with the kitchen arts to bring my customers a delicious, piping-hot Grilled Tiger Fish every single time.

719050104.text: Thanks for stopping by. It's been a while since I had such an in-depth conversation with someone...

719050105.text: This is the sword I used to use back in the day. I doubt I'll be getting in any more sword fights again in the future, so why don't you take it off my hands?
